name: ideagittool
description: The Rebased / IntelliJ git client, remade as a VS Code extension: git log with graph, commit tool window, shelf, branches popup, interactive rebase, push/update dialogs, conflicts resolver and annotations.

scripts.package: npm run contrib && node scripts/build.mjs --production && vsce package --no-dependencies

commands.title: %command.diff.openSource.title%
commands.enablement: isInDiffEditor || inDiffEditor || inMultiDiffEditor || textCompareEditorActive || activeEditor == multiDiffEditor

view/item/context.when: view == ideagittool.worktrees && viewItem =~ / linked / && viewItem =~ / unlocked/
